stories.title: Widespread service outages at major U.S. banks appear to be over
stories.summary: Customers at JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and other major financial institutions reported difficulty accessing their accounts.

stories.title: Gordie Howe International Bridge becomes most popular way to cross between Detroit, Windsor
stories.summary: The Gordie Howe International Bridge is now the most popular way to cross the border by vehicle between Michigan and Ontario, according to the latest monthly data.

stories.title: Update expected on Hutchinson's injury; FEMA test scheduled; other top stories
stories.summary: An update is expected on Tuesday regarding Aidan Hutchinson's injury during the Lions game. FEMA has scheduled an alert test for Tuesday. Those headlines and other top stories are in the CBS Detroit news brief.

stories.title: Banks respond to major system outage
stories.summary: Customers at JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, U.S. Bank and other major financial institutions reported service outages on Monday. Here's what the banks are saying in response. CBS News has this report.

stories.title: Rare draft of Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech on display
stories.summary: Several sheets of legal paper, along with an early typed draft, of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s famous "I Have a Dream" speech are on display in Atlanta before going to auction. The documents were left in a desk and found in 2024.

stories.title: Fire destroys home on Detroit's west side, no one home at the time
stories.summary: A passerby reported a house fire in progress Monday night on Appoline Street, the Detroit Fire Department said.

stories.title: FEMA to conduct national Emergency Alert System test Tuesday
stories.summary: A national test of the Emergency Alert System is scheduled for 2:20 p.m. Eastern time on Nov. 17.

stories.title: Large fire engulfs home in Detroit
stories.summary: A passerby alerted authorities to a house fire on Detroit's west side on Monday. No one was home at the time, Detroit Fire Department is still investigating.

stories.title: FEMA to test national alert system
stories.summary: A scheduled test of the Emergency Alert System is expected to happen at about 2:20 p.m. on Nov. 17. FEMA is required by law to conduct a nationwide test of the public alert and warning system at least once every three years.

stories.title: A dry week ahead with warming temps
stories.summary: Good morning, Family! A little fog/mist this morning, then becoming sunny and mild with a high of 53°. We stay dry this week with temps warming and staying above normal until Sunday when a cold front arrives with our next chance for rain.

stories.title: Stevie Wonder's Detroit performance canceled
stories.summary: Motown legend Stevie Wonder's "Songs in the Key of Life" performance in Detroit has been canceled.

stories.title: Video shows Shelby Township officer rescues man, 4-year-old boy, from burning home
stories.summary: Police shout, reach through smoke, to rescue man and 4-year-old boy from burning home in Macomb County, Michigan.
